desc:
🏙️ Welcome to Build a Skyscraper! 🏙️

🎟️ Use code "LAUNCH" for a free reward!

How to Play:
🏗️ Unlock blueprints and stack new floors
🏠 Buy rare NPCs and move them in
🛍️ Put them to work in your shops and serve customers
🔥 Upgrade your floors and grow your cash
✨ Hunt mutated NPCs to fill your Index
🏆 Build the tallest tower and flex your collection

⏰ Remember, your skyscraper keeps earning while you're offline! ⏰

👍 Like the game and join the group for +10% sale speed!
